title: nan
authors: Tang X.; Yang L.; Wang D.; Li W.; Xin D.; Jia H.
key_contribution: Proposes a collaborative navigation algorithm for UAV ad hoc networks in GNSS-denied areas combining improved sequential quadratic programming and unscented Kalman filtering, validated in simulation.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Multi_Agent_Collaborative_SLAM to ensure precise positioning.
